text:
maria (docs): hey folks — while triaging KB links I hit a 404 in guides/runtime/quickstart.md. The 'model onboarding' shortlink points to /s/model-onboard which returns 404 on prod build. Also one embedded diagram image (line ~210) 403s on CDN. Can someone take ownership?

tim (eng): which shortlink key is that? I can do a quick grep if you don't have the exact line.

maria (docs): thanks — grep output: `grep -n "model-onboard" -n content/guides/runtime/quickstart.md` -> shows at line 132 the anchor. The failing rendered href is https://docs.redwood.ai/s/model-onboard

sam (eng): hmm that shortlink should redirect to /models/onboarding. Looks like the old _redirects entry was lost in a refactor. Quick fix is to add a Netlify redirect (or update the redirects config in site-config).

jen (docs-owner): I can pick this up. I'll also swap the image embed URL to the canonical CDN path (403 likely from an expired token). Planning to open a tiny PR: fix the href and add redirect rule.

maria (docs): thanks jen. If you add a redirect it's low risk — please use branch name `fix/docs/redirect-model-onboard-2135551234` so we can trace. Also can you add a one-line test in smoke/tests/link-check to cover the shortlink?

sam (eng): example sed to patch local copy quickly:
```bash
# update inline href in the markdown file
sed -i 's|/s/model-onboard|/models/onboarding|g' content/guides/runtime/quickstart.md
# add redirect entry to site-config/_redirects (Netlify)
echo "/s/model-onboard /models/onboarding 301" >> site-config/_redirects
```

jen (docs-owner): noted. I'll open PR in ~20m. tagging @michael (eng) for review.

docs-bot: Created issue #3421 — "docs: restore redirect for /s/model-onboard and fix quickstart image CDN" (labels: docs, triage).

michael (eng): happy to review once PR is up. small nit: also check for any other shortlinks in the runtime guide that might be stale — can run `rg "/s/" content/guides/runtime` to find them.

jen (docs-owner): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5217 · includes: href replace, _redirects entry, swapped image URL to canonical CDN path, added one smoke test. Requesting review from @michael (eng) and @tim (eng).

tim (eng): looking now. quick scan — lgtm on the redirect entry.

michael (eng): reviewed, left one tiny comment about test timeout. otherwise :+1:.

jen (docs-owner): addressed comment and pushed fix. Ready to merge.

docs-bot: Pull request #5217 merged by jen (docs-owner). Deployed to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/guides/runtime/quickstart — build 2025-03-12T14:22Z.

maria (docs): verified on staging: redirect works and image loads. closing loop here — will schedule a quick sweep to find any other /s/ shortlinks next week. thanks everyone :tada:
